answer_1.quote: We perform experiments on three word-level and one sentence-level sequence-to-sequence tasks: For grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, we use NETtalk and CMUdict, two datasets for English... For morphological inflection, we use the CoNLL-SIGMORPHON 2017 shared task dataset... For transliteration, we experiment on the NEWS2015 shared task data... For this work, we consider dialect normalization as a machine translation task from dialect to standard.
answer_1.outputs: phoneme sequences, inflected forms, transliterated words, standard German translations
